rationale: No supported optimization is safely applicable to this workflow. The job already caches dependencies via setup-node `cache: yarn`, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE has an equivalent cache already present (a listed contraindication). P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is a release/deployment workflow (Deploy VitePress site, contents: write, publish step); canceling in-progress/superseded runs could leave the published site inconsistent, and the existing `cancel-in-progress: false` is the safe setting. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT lack a reliable duration baseline: the CI history shows high variance (roughly 3 to 17 minutes across runs, including a slow/cold outlier), and the VitePress build already raises the heap to 6 GB, so an arbitrary or history-derived timeout risks timing out valid slow runs (the listed contraindication). Matrix fail-fast, schedule-related patterns, test selection/prioritization, and Bazel patterns do not apply to this single-job deploy workflow with no matrix, schedule, tests, or Bazel build. Required-check status is unverified, so no change that could affect required checks is warranted.
